fusions.name: Clutch of Flints
fusions.desc: Drops a carried stone on a target up to 6 tiles away for 7 damage, rising to 1.6 times that at the full 6 tiles. It holds 3 charges, and each kill gives one back.

fusions.name: Cragfall
fusions.desc: Drops onto the target for 30 damage that ignores its armour, and leaves it 20% easier to wound for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Petrified Perch
fusions.desc: For 4 seconds, blows that reach you deal no damage and no condition can take hold of you.

fusions.name: Eyrie Gargoyle
fusions.desc: A bonded gritwing flies with you, striking enemies within 4 tiles for 4 damage every 1.4 seconds. Anything it hits moves 15% slower for 2 seconds.
